name: Purpley Pink
lede: Purpley Pink is a vivid magenta, the other compound the 2010 xkcd color survey built on [[purpley]], this time paired with pink.

sections.title: A family-word compound
sections.body:
The survey pairs "purpley" with pink here the way it pairs it with grey in [[purpley-grey]] [1]. No earlier dictionary or dye name is documented for it; the 2010 survey is the only source on file [1]. The ISCC-NBS system would call it a vivid reddish purple, 8.7 units off [1].

Its nearest named neighbor is [[pinky-purple]], 2.9 units away and duller [2]. [[steel-pink]] sits close behind, more vivid still, and the survey's own [[purpleish-pink]] is 6.5 units off, lighter [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive matches this color across even a small share of its canvas, as photographed [3]. Its high chroma makes it an unlikely survivor on an aged, varnished canvas, where pigments fade and glaze darkens long before reaching this intensity [3]. The absence describes this archive, not painting generally; like [[purpley-grey]], it is only the survey word that is new, not necessarily the hue [3].
